analysis.title: Why companies are staying private longer, and what it means for investors
key_insights: SpaceX priced the largest IPO on record on 11 June 2026, raising $75bn at a $1.77tn valuation after more than two decades as a private company. Amazon's 1997 IPO valued the company at about $430mn, less than three years after incorporation.

Anthropic was valued at $965bn in a May private round and made its IPO filing public in late October. On 10 November it set a price range of $70-78, implying a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4tn, below the $2tn or more some backers expected. Public trading is expected to begin on 19 November.

Companies list later. The median US venture-backed tech company that went public in 1995-1999 was 4 years old (ARK), 10.5 years old for 2015-2021 listings, and the median 2025 technology IPO was 12 years old (Jay Ritter).

The US public market has shrunk and concentrated. Listed domestic companies fell from about 7,500 in 1997 to just over 3,650 in 2025 (CFA Institute). The ten largest companies are about 41% of the S&P 500, roughly double their 2015 share (RBC Wealth Management).

In 2025, 995 US venture-backed companies were acquired against 62 that listed (PitchBook). Morgan Stanley counts more than 17,200 US private businesses with revenue above $100mn, against fewer than 4,060 listed companies of that size.

Private capital supply drives the shift. Anthropic's May round raised $65bn, and rounds of $100mn or more were 87.5% of US venture funding in the first half of the year (PitchBook). Sovereign wealth funds, private equity, corporates and crossover funds compete to fund leading names.

Rule and cost changes also contribute. The JOBS Act raised the holder-of-record threshold that forces public reporting from 500 to 2,000 and excluded employee plan shares. Underwriting fees average 4% to 7% of IPO proceeds. Private ownership lets capital-intensive businesses such as AI invest long term without quarterly reporting.
Tender offers give liquidity without an IPO. 16,538 employees sold equity in 2025, the highest annual total in Carta's records.

Private market assets exceeded $18tn by September 2025 (CFA Institute) and Preqin forecasts more than $34tn by 2031. Between 2003 and 2024 they grew 18-fold against roughly 3.7 times for public market assets. Secondary deals in private fund holdings reached a record $240bn in 2025 and $118bn in the first half of 2026 (Jefferies).

Global IPOs raised $290bn in the first nine months of 2026 against $114bn a year earlier, with fewer deals (EY). SpaceX's $75bn IPO and SK hynix's $26.5bn US share sale were more than two-thirds of the $147.5bn raised in the US through September.

Aftermarket results are weak. SpaceX closed day one 19.2% above its $135 offer, has traded between $104.83 and $225.64, and closed at $139.75 on 11 November. Its market cap swung from nearly $3tn to around $1.37tn. The 40 largest US IPOs since January 2025 had a median return of -12.5% from offer by 16 October, and 31 of 40 trailed the S&P 500 (Uniqus).
Companies that listed below their last private valuation have held up better than those that listed above it (Uniqus), and secondary market data point the same way.

Private investing has costs. Average VC holding period rose from about 2 years in 2000 to nearly 6 (MSCI). Pre-IPO holders may face lock-ups per the S-1. Transaction fees on pre-IPO shares are typically 2% to 4% on regulated US platforms (Forge). Valuations are marked periodically or to model and can lag reality.

Buyout funds outperformed comparable public markets on average over the 25 years to September 2025 (MSCI). Syz says the choice is how to combine public and private exposure and how much illiquidity a portfolio can carry. Tests ahead are Anthropic's debut, SpaceX's final lock-up release and the performance of newer retail-access structures.

market_movers.rationale: Anthropic's IPO is expected to begin public trading on 19 November at a $70-78 range, up to $1.4tn fully diluted, below the $2tn some backers expected. Syz calls it the next test for private valuations.

crypto_views: Syz says deeper secondary trading and structures such as Hyperliquid perpetual futures on pre-IPO names are improving price discovery in private company shares.
risk_factors: Lock-up expirations, including SpaceX's final lock-up release, can pressure newly listed shares.
Private valuations lag reality because holdings are valued periodically or marked to model.
Holding periods of nearly 6 years, transaction fees of 2% to 4% and illiquidity limit private exposure.
A technology sell-off is reducing demand for high AI valuations, which Syz links to Anthropic's range coming in below backer expectations.
IPO proceeds are concentrated in a few very large deals, and newer listings are trailing the S&P 500.
vol_and_positioning: SpaceX's market cap swung from nearly $3tn to around $1.37tn after its IPO, which Syz cites as volatility that private valuations conceal. A technology sell-off is weighing on appetite for high AI valuations.

tension_points.bull_case: Private markets give access to the fastest growth years. SpaceX's valuation rose from about $10bn in 2015 to $1.77tn at IPO, and buyout funds outperformed comparable public markets over 25 years to September 2025 (MSCI).
tension_points.bear_case: The 40 largest US IPOs since January 2025 had a median return of -12.5% from offer, 31 of 40 trailed the S&P 500, and SpaceX's market cap swung from nearly $3tn to about $1.37tn. Private marks lag reality.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Anthropic's debut, expected 19 November after a $70-78 range set below the $2tn some backers expected, is named as the next test of private valuations.

theme_stances.key_argument: Private markets are not replacing public markets, and the question for long-term investors is how to combine them and how much illiquidity a portfolio can carry.
theme_stances.evidence: Private markets are not replacing public markets

theme_stances.key_argument: A technology sell-off has weighed on appetite for high AI valuations, and Anthropic's range implies up to $1.4tn against the $2tn or more some backers expected.
